The first playable frame in half the time on a desktop
The same on a slowed phone (1.96 times faster: not quite)

captions.text: The game's initial loading time is quite bad.
I timed it first. Thirty-seven seconds.
The GPU compiled one pass at a time, as each was first drawn.
Everything else waited. The page too.
Every texture was painted four times over.
Now each is compiled once, side by side, for where it is drawn.
Fifteen seconds now, on the desktop.
On the phone, twenty-four. Almost half.
Measured without a GPU. The iPhone's own numbers are still to come.
